def transform(grid):

    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        stack.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append((color, cells))
    # The short, isolated line at the top identifies the color to use.
    marker = next((color for color, cells in comps
                   if len(cells) == 2 and
                   (cells[0][0] == cells[1][0] or cells[0][1] == cells[1][1]) and
                   min(r for r,c in cells) < 3), None)
    if marker is not None:
        # Recolor the large, irregular object in the lower portion.
        candidates = [(color, cells) for color, cells in comps
                      if color != marker and len(cells) >= 5 and min(r for r,c in cells) >= h//2]
        if candidates:
            color, cells = max(candidates, key=lambda item: len(item[1]))
            for r, c in cells:
                out[r][c] = marker
    return out
